summary: Engadget's Amy Skorheim rounds up Apple Black Friday deals that are expected to continue through the weekend into Cyber Monday. The guide covers AirPods, MacBooks, Apple Watches, iPads and accessories, noting new record lows and prices matching earlier lows. Each entry includes the sale price, retailers, and a recommendation based on Engadget's reviews.
one_line: Engadget's roundup of the best Apple Black Friday 2023 deals on AirPods, MacBooks, Apple Watches, iPads and accessories, with prices and recommendations.
key_facts: The AirPods Pro (2nd gen, USB-C) dropped to $190 at Amazon, Target and Best Buy, within a dollar of the recent low of $189; the Lightning version is $169 at Walmart and $185 at Verizon.
The AirPods Max hit a new low of $450 at Amazon and Best Buy, $30 cheaper than October's Prime Day, and cost $519 at B&H Photo.
The third generation AirPods are $140 at Amazon, Target and Best Buy (list price $169); they got a review score of 88, lack ANC, and have Adaptive EQ.
The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M3 is $150 off; the M3 Pro model is $200 off at $2,199 at B&H Photo, and Engadget recommends 16GB of RAM over the 8GB base model.
The 15-inch MacBook Air (M2, 2023) is $1,049 at Amazon and Best Buy, matching its all-time low, and received a review score of 96.
The 13-inch MacBook Air (M2, 2022) is $929 at B&H Photo and is Engadget's top MacBook recommendation; M3 Airs are expected in 2024.
The M1 MacBook Air is $750 at Amazon and Best Buy, matching its Prime Day low, and is Engadget's budget pick for MacBooks and budget laptops.
The Apple Watch Ultra 2 is $730 with an Amazon coupon ($69 off, a new low), or $739 at Best Buy without the coupon.
The Apple Watch Series 9 hit a new low of $330 at Amazon, Target and Walmart ($70 off), and features Double Tap via a new SiP chip.
The Apple Watch SE is $179 (list price $249), and Engadget called it the best smartwatch money can buy when it came out in 2022.
The 9th gen iPad is $230 at Amazon and Target, the 10th gen is $349, the iPad Air is $499 (MSRP $599), and the iPad mini is $400.
A $100 Apple gift card at Amazon comes with $15 in Amazon credit using code APPLET5USA (digital) or APPLET5USAP (physical).
A four-pack of AirTags is $80 at Amazon (19 percent off), and the Apple TV 4K is $125 at B&H Photo (review score 94).
The base Mac mini with the M2 chip is $100 off and earned an 86 in review; the 512GB SSD model is $699 at B&H Photo.
